THIS MFA COMING ON FOR CONCI LIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT AFTER BEING REFFERED BY THE COURT, THE FOLLOWING CON CILIATION ORD ER I S PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
Representative of the appellant-insurer along with its counsel and counsel for respondent no.1-claimant are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.
The Appellant-insurer has filed a joint memo seeking to withdraw the appeal.
Joint memo is taken on record.
3. The Miscellaneous First Appeal is dismissed as withdrawn in terms of the Joint Memo.
4. Amount in deposit before this Court, if any, shall be transmitted to the Tribunal, forthwith.

5. Draw up the award accordingly.
Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
